bio: Sporting his checked shirt and blue apron, Rémi officiates behind what was likely the counter of this former betting shop, which has been turned into a cosy little bistro. On the menu for lunch today: a tasty chicken liver terrine; redfish bream with its delicious fumet; poached peach, financier and creamy house-made vanilla ice cream. One of the major draws is the restaurant's friendly atmosphere. Photos of the chef and his past co-workers adorn the walls, and a blackboard features the day's set menus. Customers collect their wine from the wine cellar, whether to accompany their meal here or to take home. Welcome to Rémi's!...
